description: This file defines the AzureAIEmbedding class, which is a specialized implementation for handling text and image embeddings using Azure AI services. It includes methods for synchronous and asynchronous embedding requests, response processing, and handles integration with both HTTP and asynchronous HTTP clients. The class extends OpenAIChatCompletion and interacts with various internal modules for request transformation and response conversion.
